experimentsSemanticMap.purpose: Reproducible bounded comparisons of worker output policies, including retrieval costs and failure visibility.
experimentsSemanticMap.producer: Human/agent workflow contract; recorder creates immutable JSONL and private captures.
contract: first recorded action includes supplied AGENTS read and literal recorder; verified symbol or outline route
Python3 POSIX groups; cwd/HEAD and traversal/symlink validation; private captures 0600 and directories 0700
preview limit default example 8000; >12000 requires reason; max30000; capture has no disk quota
admission budgets may overshoot; timeout owns process group but not detached/shared daemons
ledger includes admitted children only; preflight refusals saved separately; host bytes/tokens unknown unless independently measured
bounded digest allowlist; strings<=512, limitations<=8; immutable primaries and distinct follow-up ledgers
fresh nonce retained-row check; preserve exit, warning and failure visibility before cost comparison
VM settle is event-loop waiting; bounded stepUntil readiness with ok/steps assertion; no rendering/DOM/GPU inference
experimentsSemanticMap.validity: Current documented method, not an executed experiment or proof of a policy winner.
experimentsSemanticMap.cleanup: Keep failed attempts and original captures; never overwrite primaries or reconstruct missing records from estimates.
